field.name: Product Highlights
field.value: Wide toe-box mesh walking sneakers with broad diagonal side bands and a curved toe overlay. The contrasting panel layout gives this low-top shoe a sporty casual appearance. Traditional laces allow the upper to be adjusted for the wearer. Black, White, Beige; EU 36-48 provide color and size choices for wholesale assortments. Original-style wholesale orders start from 2 pairs, allowing buyers to request a small trial assortment.
What are the available colors and sizes?
Black, White, Beige; EU 36-48. List the pair quantity for each color and EU size to request your assortment.
A mesh upper with broad diagonal contrast bands and a curved toe overlay. This is a low-top shoe with a conventional lace-up closure.
How should I choose a size?

This style has a wider toe-box design. Use EU sizes and compare your foot length with the size information for this style. For a trial fitting, choose your usual EU size and assess a sample with the socks you plan to wear.
What is the minimum order for the original style?
The original-style wholesale minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page. Logo, material or custom packaging requests are quoted separately from the original-style order.
How can I arrange a sample?
Request a sample quotation with your preferred color, EU size and delivery postcode. The quotation will include the sample charge, shipping cost and proposed dispatch schedule.
What should I send for a branding or packaging quotation?
Send your logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. We can review the brief for this style and provide a proposal with the applicable minimum, cost and sample process.
How can I get a delivered quotation and shipment schedule?

Send the color-size quantities and destination postcode or port, plus any packaging request. The quotation separates product cost from freight and sets out the dispatch plan and estimated transit time for your chosen shipping method.
